public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI made $13.07 billion in revenue in 2025, only $70 million more than $13 billion, with $862 million from SoftBank.

statement.excerpt: In the end, per my own reporting, “well more” would mean “$70 million,” with OpenAI making $13.07 billion in revenue in 2025, with SoftBank accounting for $862 million.

our_interpretation: Assess calendar-2025 realized revenue, not an annualized run rate.
Read SoftBank's contribution as revenue recognized from SoftBank or its group companies, excluding equity financing.
The $70 million comparison is arithmetic against $13 billion, not a separately reported revenue measure.
Treat the speaker's own reporting as an estimate basis rather than assume a particular accounting standard.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable records establish $13.07 billion in total 2025 revenue and $862 million attributable to SoftBank; the stated $70 million difference follows from that total.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records establish a materially different total or SoftBank contribution. Investment proceeds or future purchasing commitments do not settle customer revenue.
